current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly my mood… the swings and irritability, and it gets tied up with my relationship stuff. It’s worst before my period, like about a week or so before, and then it settles once it starts.
current_concerns.goals: Mostly I want to get the mood swings under control, honestly. And… keep it from wrecking relationships. That’s really the main thing.
